title: Antigravity locale definition
description: Language data consumed by src/locale.js and injected into the locale-neutral engine at src/patches/engine.jsfrag. Adding a language means adding one file of this shape.

$schema.description: Points at this file so editors can offer completion and validation.

language.description: BCP 47 locale code. Must match the file name, e.g. zh-CN for zh-CN.json.

name.description: Display name written in the language itself, e.g. 简体中文.

englishName.description: English display name used in CLI listings, e.g. Simplified Chinese.

htmlLang.description: Value written to <html lang>. Defaults to 'language' when omitted.

punctuation.description: ASCII punctuation to localized punctuation, applied only to trailing punctuation of a dictionary hit. Leave empty for languages that keep ASCII punctuation.

punctuationSkipSuffixes.description: If a translation already ends with one of these, trailing punctuation is not appended again.

patterns.description: Rules for strings containing runtime values (counts, durations, model names) that cannot be listed in 'text'.

id.description: Unique identifier used in validation errors. Duplicates are rejected.

pattern.description: JavaScript regular expression source. Anchor it with ^...$ so it cannot match a substring of unrelated UI text.

template.description: Output text. {1}, {2}, ... expand to capture groups; referencing a group the pattern does not have is rejected.

replace.description: Capture group index to the name of a valueMaps or valueRules entry used to localize that group.

trimGroups.description: Capture group indexes whose surrounding whitespace is stripped before lookup.

sample.description: Representative input. The test suite asserts the rule matches this string and actually changes it.

valueMaps.description: Named lookup tables for enumerable captured values. Unmatched values fall through unchanged.

valueRules.description: Named regex pipelines for captured values that are not enumerable, such as '2 days, 3 hours'. Each step is applied in order.

menu.description: Native application menu labels. Applied in the main process, not the renderer, so these are kept out of the preload fragment.

text.description: Static dictionary: exact English UI string to its translation. Keys must not have surrounding whitespace and values must be non-empty.
